[[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Gwellib Ap-Llewff]] wielded a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] during the reign of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
[[File:Inquisitortraining.jpg|left|thumb|Gwellib Ap-Llewff training with the other Inquisitors.]]
Gwellib wielded the lightsaber in a training session with fellow Inquisitors [[Antinnis Tremayne]], [[Lanu Pasiq]], and [[Halmere]], while the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] watched the session. Inquisitor Tremayne very quickly overwhelmed him and the other Inquisitors by disarming them of their lightsabers and wielding all four blades at once.<ref name="EAR" />

Gwellib continued to use the lightsaber even up to when he joined Darth Sidious's [[Dark Empire]],<ref name="DES" /> as late as [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].<ref name="Comics Companion">''[[Star Wars: The Comics Companion]]''</ref>
